metadata.description: Skills and agents for business reporting that follows the IBCS® Standards: notation, page design, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric apps and the data behind them.

plugins.name: ibcs
plugins.description: IBCS®-style business reporting: notation (scenarios, variances, colours, tokens), page composition with a visual spec, web chart components, and a review checklist with a linter.

plugins.name: ibcs-power-bi
plugins.description: Build IBCS®-style Power BI reports: card routes per visual, Deneb (Vega-Lite) chart templates with token sync, and SVG-in-DAX tables.

plugins.name: fabric-apps
plugins.description: Build and deploy IBCS®-style reporting apps on Microsoft Fabric, and package Power BI content as org apps.

plugins.name: reporting-data
plugins.description: The data behind reporting: a semantic model that serves IBCS® visuals, a SQL gold layer for reporting, and source mappings for Dynamics 365 ERP.
